decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings extend the firm's core drainage engineering and housing know-how, so it can interpret results and refine the line easily.
Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's central competence and strategic direction, giving it strong absorptive capacity to improve the line.
As the flagship designer shower drain, it builds directly on proven drainage technology and the firm's design focus, so management will keep investing in it.
A shower element with integrated slope complements the firm's floor-level systems and waterproofing know-how, though it sits somewhat further from metal fabrication.
The backflow-protected basement drain applies the firm's established drainage and sealing expertise to a related segment and has prominent dedicated presentation.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral piping accessory with weaker links to the firm's core design-drain knowledge, but it rounds out the drainage system offer cheaply.
